name: Snack Pack Chocolate Pudding Cup
whyItWorks: Rich chocolate taste in an ultra-smooth pudding matrix. Unlike heavy chocolate candy bars with high cocoa butter fats, pudding has minimal fat and negligible theobromine, satisfying sweet cravings safely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy chilled or room-temperature. Pair with a lactase pill if dairy-sensitive.
watchOuts: Contains mild cocoa and nonfat milk; enjoy in moderation if sensitive to chocolate.
